fields.why: Table 1 gives weighted e-cigarette prevalence for four age groups, four race/ethnicity groups and three income groups, with 'highest among' claims.

Age, race/ethnicity and family income (3 levels plus unknown) qualify; education and insurance are pairs, sex is a pair, and region, industry and occupation (framed as workplace exposure) are not SPDs.
A blanket 'two-sided t-tests ... between point estimates' under 'highest among' claims is exactly the brief's per-group vs referent only case, with resolves_to_finer true.
